user.strategy_description: Team total under when wind/bad weather or strong opposing D (variation)
user.strategy_long_explanation: Uses KXNFLTEAMTOTAL + weather + defensive DVOA. Entry wind >15mph or vs top 5 D and price over >0.55. Position 1.5%. Why work: defense + weather suppresses scoring. Why fail: shootout. Evidence: under hits 56% in wind games.
